description: This PHP file defines the class assignment_mgr, which manages assignment activities related to users, features, and builds within the TestLink testing platform. It includes methods for retrieving, deleting, assigning, updating, and copying user assignments, as well as generating reports on assignment counts and sending notification links.

classes.name: assignment_mgr
classes.description: Manages assignment activities such as creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting user assignments related to testing features and builds in TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes assignment_mgr with a database connection reference.

methods.name: get_available_types
methods.description: Retrieves available assignment types, optionally keyed by a specified field.

methods.name: get_available_status
methods.description: Retrieves available assignment statuses, optionally keyed by a specified field.

methods.name: delete_by_feature_id
methods.description: Deletes assignments associated with specified feature IDs or list of feature IDs.

methods.name: delete_by_build_id
methods.description: Deletes assignments associated with a specific build ID, optionally for all types or solely tester assignments.

methods.name: delete_by_feature_id_and_build_id
methods.description: Deletes assignments matching feature IDs and build ID, provided via a feature map.

methods.name: deleteBySignature
methods.description: Deletes assignments matching a list of signature objects containing feature, build, user, etc.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns users to features with specified types and statuses, inserting new assignment records if they do not exist.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing assignment records with new field values based on feature ID.

methods.name: get_count_of_assignments_for_build_id
methods.description: Returns the number of user assignments for a specific build ID, optionally counting all types or only tester assignments.

methods.name: get_not_run_tc_count_per_build
methods.description: Counts the number of assigned test cases that are not yet executed, per build, optionally filtered by user.

methods.name: copy_assignments
methods.description: Copies assignment records from one build to another, with options to keep existing, include all types, and filter by features.

methods.name: getExecAssignmentsCountByBuild
methods.description: Returns a hashmap with build IDs and counts of test case execution assignments.

methods.name: getNotRunAssignmentsCountByBuild
methods.description: Returns a hashmap with build IDs and counts of assigned test cases that are not yet executed.

methods.name: getUsersByFeatureBuild
methods.description: Retrieves a map of feature IDs to user IDs for a given set of features, build, and assignment type.

methods.name: emailLinkToExecPlanning
methods.description: Sends emails with links to execution planning for users assigned in a specific context, optionally filtering by target users.
